jobs.title: Consultor de sistemas BESS y FV
jobs.description:
Estamos buscando un Consultor especializado/a en proyectos renovables. Te unirás a nuestro equipo de Consultoría de Iberia y tu responsabilidad se centrará en la gestión de proyectos BESS y fotovoltaicos.  

Requirements

  • Grado en Ingeniería Eléctrica o similar 
  • 3 – 5 años de experiencia 
  • Experiencia previa como consultor 
  • Experiencia previa en la revisión, preparación y gestión de contratos EPC  
  • Experiencia previa en supervisión de la construcción 
  • Conocimiento transversal demostrable de Plantas BESS 
  • Capacidad de trabajar en remoto

Tareas principales

  • Gestionar la construcción de proyectos BESS como Ingeniería de la propiedad 
  • Realizar la ingeniería básica de sistemas BESS y FV 
  • Revisar ingenierías de detalle de sistemas BESS y FV 
  • Revisar contratos EPC y de suministros de componentes principales 
  • Coordinación del equipo y tareas del proyecto 
  • Realizar visitas semanales a los proyectos  
  • Generar informes de seguimiento 
  • Mantener y gestionar las comunicaciones con los clientes 
  • Supervisión de subestaciones eléctricas
  • Dar soporte en la tramitación y desarrollo de sistemas BESS

Idiomas

  • Español e inglés
  • Portugués e italiano son un plus.

Software requerido

  • AutoCAD 
  • PVsyst 
  • PVCase 
  • Microsoft 365 
  • QGIS 
  • Python 

Benefits

¿Qué ofrecemos?

  • Salario acorde con la experiencia laboral  
  • Seguro médico privado 
  • Retribución flexible con Edenred 
  • Formación en hard-skills y soft-skills 
  • Jornada intensiva de verano

jobs.title: SaaS Support Engineer Internship
jobs.description:
As a SaaS Support Engineer Intern, you will play a key role in ensuring the smooth running of our services while maintaining a high level of customer satisfaction. You will be instrumental in maintaining our SynaptiQ platform and providing first-level support to our clients, as well as assisting with onboarding and with development of new features.

Your key responsibilities will be:

1. Client Support and Engagement:

  • Handle first-level support tickets from clients, providing efficient solutions to technical issues and escalating more complex problems to the Senior SaaS Engineer team when necessary.
  • Assist the service delivery team with the deployment of assets into the SynaptiQ platform.
  • Understand clients' needs and translate these into appropriate technical solutions.
  • Assist with the helpdesk and ticketing system, performing offsite analysis, and providing guidance in the installation of equipment.

2. Platform Development:

  • Provide input/ideas for the development and maintenance of the SynaptiQ platform.
  • Implement the appropriate configuration of newly developed features under the supervision of Senior SaaS Engineers.
  • Adhere to quality standards to ensure the software meets both technical and customer needs.

3. Testing and Debugging:

  • Carry out testing of new features and updates, identifying bugs and ensuring the platform's stable operation.
  • Provide detailed reports on bugs and assist in their resolution.

4. Process Improvement:

Propose creative solutions to improve or automate internal tools and processes and implement solutions.

5. Continuous Learning:

  • Keep abreast of the latest developments in SaaS technologies and platforms.
  • Continually improve your knowledge and skills to contribute more effectively to the team.

As a part of our team, you will have the opportunity to develop your skills and explore a varied range of topics. Upon completion of your traineeship, there is the potential for you to secure a long-term employment contract with us.

Requirements

To successfully fill this role, we are looking for someone fitting the following profile:

  • You are enrolled in an Engineering degree (in renewable energy, mechanical, electrical engineering or related field) or you have recently completed one.
  • You have full proficiency in English.
  • You have strong analytical skills to analyse data flows (i.e. through FTP, API or SQL Data collectors, UI dashboards etc).
  • You have excellent communication skills, proactive attitude and customer-oriented mindset.
  • You have a curious mindset, always looking for ways to improve processes and tooling.
  • You are interested in SaaS products and ready to deep dive into it.

Bonus points for:

  • You have knowledge of French and/or Dutch.
  • You are familiar with object-based programming languages (JavaScript, Python, VBA).
  • You have knowledge of databases and operating systems.
  • You are experienced with MySQL or other relational database management system.

Benefits

Our offices are hidden in the centre of Brussels with a view on a pond, with ducks and a heron bringing a regular visit. In addition to a stimulating atmosphere in a highly motivated group of people, 3E offers a unique opportunity to further develop yourself in a company/team with an ambitious growth plan, delivering innovative services.

Furthermore:

  • A 6-month full-time traineeship.
  • Possibility to permanently join the team after the completion of your internship.
  • Training on the job by our experts so you get to know our solution and work in and out
  • Flexibility in our open-minded company.
  • Home working (2 days per week)
  • An international environment: projects in over 100 countries worldwide, colleagues of over 20 nationalities.

>> Check-out what Simon has to say about what it means to work as a SaaS Engineer at 3E: Working as a SaaS Engineer at 3E

jobs.title: TALENT POOL: Junior Solar or Wind Engineer (BE)
jobs.description:
>>>This is a Talent Pool!

By submitting your CV here, you are expressing your interest in becoming part of our talent pool and thus allowing us to consider you for future opportunities as Junior Solar or Wind Engineer in Brussels.

In this role, you will be delighting our clients (developers, IPPs, banks, investors etc.) with your energy yield estimations for utility scale solar and/or wind projects while gradually getting trained in performing feasibility studies, Due Diligences or Owner’s Engineering tasks either from the office or during site inspections.

Your main tasks will be:

  • You will perform the energy yield calculations using industry-recognised software tools and internal tools and processes.
  • You will analyse the results.
  • You will produce the client reports.
  • You will perform technical feasibility studies.
  • You will perform site inspections before, during and after construction of the projects after the requested trainings.
  • Over time, you will also start interacting directly with customers, written as well as verbally.

You will work within the core of our consultancy team which will give you all at hand to quickly explore the wonderful world of solar or wind. At first, you will work on a project managed by one of your colleagues and gradually you will be taking the role of project manager yourself.

Requirements

We are looking for a dynamic colleague who is eager to learn, who can bring an open and flexible mindset and who has very strong organisational skills.

Of course, there are some non-negotiables:

  • You have a Master's degree in engineering.
  • You have a strong interest in renewable energies and this reflects in your way of life.
  • You are fluent in English (spoken and written).

What gives you extra points:

  • Knowledge on PVsyst and/or WindPro, AutoCAD, PVCase …
  • Knowledge in coding using Python.
  • Available for short trips abroad (during the project construction monitoring period).

We will make sure you are smoothly onboarded within our team, teaching you all in-and-outs of the role.

Benefits

Our offices are hidden in the centre of Brussels with a view on a pond, with ducks and a heron bringing a regular visit. In addition to a stimulating atmosphere in a highly motivated group of people, 3E offers a unique opportunity to further develop yourself in a company/team with an ambitious growth plan, delivering innovative services.

Furthermore:

  • Attractive salary package in line with your level of experience, including group insurance, hospital insurance, meal vouchers (8 euros), eco vouchers, representation allowance, company mobile phone + subscription, 32 days of vacation and a flex income plan.
  • Sustainable transport: easy access with public transport, 100% reimbursement of public transport fare, bicycle allowance.
  • Flexibility in our open-minded company, with gliding and flexible working hours and short communication lines.
  • Home working (2 days per week).
  • An international environment: projects in over 100 countries worldwide, colleagues of 20 nationalities.

>> Check-out what Pablo has to say about what it means to work as a Consultant at 3E: Working as a PV Consultant at 3E
